string.ID: Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.

strings.string: 啊！呱 愿给你这份恩惠，呱 愿意。若不是未来亲族无声哭喊，自由如木烟却不再长久安全。呱 愿意却不能。

string.ID:
All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.
rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.

strings.string:
一切都好，=name=！试炼生来就是要被克服，而且要一起克服。
呱 能分辨天黑，却也不知。来访并见证！发光帽让夜晚活起来，安全又自由。斯林思之家就是伊德。

string.ID:
{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}
Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.

string.ID: rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.

strings.string: 居民叫 呱 戈埃克。呱 也是这里的居民，在那之前，是地方的建造者。戈埃克、吉厄布、马克和多眼在礁中建造新伊德，数百年。

string.ID: rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.

strings.string: 呱 从前建造过，但 呱 如今都建造它。

string.ID: rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!

strings.string: 呱 是斯瓦尔丁，像从蛋里出来的幼体一样，但沿着岁月滑槽滚了几百年，长得这么长、这么多疣！呱 也曾是幼体，一想到就想哭！

string.ID: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 是，呱 曾经是，天空中的“瘟灾”数百年。现在不是了。很久以来，呱、吉厄布、马克藏在海绵里吃虱子。找到多眼后，呱 和朋友们建造了伊德。快乐帮助！

string.ID: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.

strings.string: 瘟灾盛放千年，然后衰败，缩回地海绵之下，或迁到这里和东方。万塔、吉尔什幼体、腐烂死去。幼体 呱 曾见拿非利显现！呱 害怕，躲进海绵里三十个月亮。

string.ID:
rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.
Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!
rrk rrkself.

strings.string:
呱 读标牌，走下楼梯。呱 呼吸水烟，坐在海星上。
拜访棚屋，见朋友马克、吉厄布、贝普、克尔卡、乌恩、蒂利、农夫罗卡斯，还有每一个其他！
呱 是 呱 自己。

string.ID: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.

strings.string: 是，我们在场，虽然没有其他身体那样活跃。但我们看见了，也因记忆遗物而作响，像商会锁箱因珠宝而作响；一片亿年旧数据盘的碎片，故事与地点的零星残片。亲族逃离，虱子餐食，骇人的无聊。但命运的反复无常带我们走过历史的足迹。曾有机器言说者，还有她的熊形学徒和他的小植物，播种者带着四个胖墩墩的小崽子，然后，最后，多眼。我们亲爱的 加尔加尔。太多了。

string.ID: Live and drink, Krka.
bep see widget? Or bep see widget.

strings.string: 贝普 看小玩意？或者 贝普 看见小玩意。

strings.string: 贝普 曾经是蛋里来的瓦尔丁。

strings.string: 呱？贝普 用火，把黄铜弯成环球 呱，给图书馆。

string.ID: bep make all and anys. bep too lounge in green-gold cubby, smoke pillow and Krka and Tilli.

strings.string: 贝普 做所有和任何。贝普 也躺绿金小窝，抽枕头，和克尔卡、蒂利。

string.ID: I'm fine, thank you. Live and drink.
Live and drink, Rokhas.
NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 多眼，你能告诉我 马科姆 伊德 的事吗？

SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM. BY TRETE WITH SAAD CALLEN MOLOCH, AND MONEIEN BI ALDERSESSE.
BY TRETE GALGALLIM BILDEN PIPE TO DRINKEN THANE SLIPSTREAM, AND FORGE TO BURNEN STEL-CRISTAL, AND CASKE TO HOLDEN GLOUINGE O FISH.

strings.string:
由萨卢姆释放的南中枢。凭与名为摩洛的 萨阿德 所立之约，并由长老会拨款。
凭约，加尔加利姆 建管以饮 领主 滑流，建炉以燃钢晶，建箱以盛鱼之辉光。

string.ID: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.

strings.string: 凭约，加尔加利姆 曾服役，但现在不。

string.ID: YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 你。你此处不统治。非摩洛在 马科姆 伊德。

string.ID: Live and drink, Thah.
I have changed my mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我改变主意了。长存，畅饮。

string.ID: I decline. Live and drink.
Live and drink. I will return with news.

strings.string: 长存，畅饮。我会带消息回来。

string.ID: None yet. Live and drink, Thah.

Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.
Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.

strings.string:
你说的是巴拉瑟姆派？原来是这么发音的。
砂砾门是，啊……那是 Q 女孩住的地方，对吗？她写了我最喜欢的书，{{W|拟怪病论}}。我想这样的家会对我的族人产生积极影响。我会和他们谈谈。

string.ID:
Kyakukya? I didn't realize it had so many syllables.
That's where the, ah, faithful to the ape-god gather, correct? And, uh... Crowsong, as well. I will present this possibility to my people and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
基亚库亚？我没意识到它有这么多音节。
那是，啊，猿神信众聚集的地方，对吗？还有，呃……鸦歌也在那里。我会把这个可能性呈给我的族人，我们会商议。

string.ID:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?
The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?

strings.string:
以斯拉 是，啊，锭柱底部的村庄，对吗？
那是真正的历史摇篮。倒不是说我的族人对历史有强烈兴趣，但也许生活在壁画和浅浮雕之间，会改变他们的，啊，集体视野？

string.ID: Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.

strings.string: 真迷人。我对这些 莫潘戈 一无所知，但任何以热爱学习和发现来定义自己的族群，在我看来都，啊……很好。我会和族人商议，看看他们是否同意。

string.ID:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.
But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
选择 弃民，啊……其中有种悲伤。我的一些族人梦想着归属，而这个词本身就是归属的反面。
不过，如果流浪者彼此照看，那其中也有一种归属。即便孤身一人，我们也并不孤独。我会把这个选择交给其他人，我们会商议。

string.ID:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.
But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.

strings.string:
附近的聚落？那个，啊，由三个 斯瓦尔迪姆 和一个 加尔加尔 创立的地方？我光是知道最基本的事实，就一直怕得要命，不敢过去。
但你说他们会接纳我们？也许我错了。

string.ID:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.
There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.

strings.string:
贝拉赫 真的存在？真让我惊得染上颜色……我，啊，一直以为 兴德伦 全都散居各处。
如果斯林思迁往一个神话般又隐秘的村庄，这其中有种不可否认的诗意。我会和我的族人商议。

string.ID: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 基亚库亚 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 以斯拉 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 墓冢中的 莫潘戈 同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: If the slynth choose to wander Qud, the Pariahs have agreed to look after them.

strings.string: 如果斯林思选择游荡库德，弃民 已经同意照看他们。

string.ID: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 贝拉赫 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: I will cherish it. Live and drink.

After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Kyakukya shall be the new home of the slynth. There are many ways to grow when one is planted in the very heart of Qud.
Our emigration party departs for the river in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：基亚库亚 将成为斯林思的新家。当一个人被栽在库德正中心时，会有许多成长的方式。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往河畔。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the villagers of Ezra, harvesting musa alongside the banana ranchers and singing their songs.
Our emigration party departs for Omonporch in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思的新家将在 以斯拉 村民之中，和香蕉牧人一起采收 穆萨，唱他们的歌。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往欧蒙门廊。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become mopango, taking root in ancient rock and casting our gaze back toward the history that preceded us.
Our emigration party departs for the Tomb of the Eaters in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思将成为 莫潘戈，在古老岩石中扎根，把目光投向先于我们存在的历史。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往食客之墓。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is no home at all, but the floating fellowship of Qud's Pariahs. We were blessed with roots that need not fix themselves to the soil and have opted to use them accordingly.
We will split into parties and leave to meet with other wayfarers come morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思的新家根本不是家，而是库德 弃民 的流动同伴群。我们有幸拥有不必固定在土壤里的根，于是选择相应地使用它们。
到了早晨，我们会分成几队离开，去与其他旅人会合。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Bey Lah shall be the new home of the slynth. There is a familiarity to this tucked-away village, newly greeting the world; this is our gentle emergence from obscurity, and one not undertaken alone.
Our emigration party departs for the flower fields in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：贝拉赫 将成为斯林思的新家。这个隐匿的村庄正在新近迎接世界，它带着一种熟悉感；这是我们温柔地走出晦暗，而且并非独自前行。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往花田。

string.ID: May Oboroqoru be merciful.

strings.string: 愿 奥博罗科鲁 施以慈悲。

string.ID: Mayest thou rest ever in the Light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string: 愿汝永息于 卡萨辉体 之光。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。花田听起来很美，而且毫无疑问，兴德伦 身上有许多值得学习的东西。但一想到守望摇篮数十年后要离开它……我做不到。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID: New creature. Live and drink.
I see. Live and drink.
Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我会去拜访。长存，畅饮。

string.ID: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...

strings.string: 我在 恩罗伊 交谈过的实体提到了一块鸣响之石……

string.ID: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.

strings.string: 旅人 =name=，这片冠层在我位于 恩罗伊 的树干上方漫游，而我的梦越过长阶。你找到了我，也找到了冠层中这数十道共同鸣响的声音。

string.ID: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，迪夫拉赫。长存，畅饮。

string.ID: Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?

strings.string: 这又使我一惊，但平静下来后，好奇随之而来。你说的是那些拥有肢体、能够自由行动的发光族民。你希望他们像我们的 桑特 一样加入我们吗？

string.ID: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.

strings.string: 你来得正好，=name=。虽然已有几位选择离开、成为独立的自己，第一批斯林思仍像我们的 桑特 一样加入了我们：他们能够自由行动、彼此分离，却也共享此地、共同生活。这是一种从未成形过的可能；它会伸出怎样的枝杈？我期待亲眼见证。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}
It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以悠长音调鸣响。*}}
这是 裂衣礼，也就是裂衣礼，旅人。我正在守丧，因此以低音鸣响。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I swim in cool and dark waters, traveler. For me, it is Shiva, the lament of seven thousand years.
I mourn the passing of all life, and all the necessity of death life must bring. For you, traveler, to come here, how many had to die? I mourn them.
Or are you the rarest one, who walks below the bright arches and claims no such cost? Even then, what losses did {{M|you}} suffer to come, traveler? What selves of yours had you to shed? Those are -else to us, and I mourn them as well.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以深沉音调鸣响。*}}
我游在清冷黑暗的水中，旅人。对我而言，这是 七日守丧，是延续了七千年的“七日守丧”。
我哀悼一切生命的逝去，也哀悼生命必然带来的所有死亡。为了让你来到这里，旅人，必须有多少存在死去？我哀悼他们。
又或者，你是最稀有的那一种，走在明亮拱门之下，却声称不曾付出这种代价？即便如此，{{M|你}} 为了来到这里又承受了什么损失，旅人？你必须舍弃哪些曾经可能成为的自己？对我们而言，那些也是逝去的生命，我同样为它们哀悼。

string.ID: I should go. Live and drink.
I will think on this... live and drink.

strings.string: 我会思考这件事……长存，畅饮。

string.ID:
Ah.
Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?
I do not wish to know you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊。
好吧。感谢你帮助我完成离枝，可你又阻断了我的道路，制造出新的问题。对吗？
我不想认识你。
长存，畅饮。

string.ID:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?
I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
我怨恨降临在我身上的事，但我仍有形体。你仍然帮助我活了下来，对吗？
